assertions.name: full_voldensity_overshoots_and_rho_aa_is_hbar_q_sq
assertions.source: Full proton-VolDensity route (Vol/ℏ_q²×linking_weight) applied to 7²_1 overshoots b_αα by >100× (H₄: 259×), AND the AME-implied density ρ_αα=b_emp·ℏ_q²/(m_e·Vol) equals ℏ_q² to <1% (0.9955). Scope-(a): the ℏ_q² Planck enhancement belongs to the rest-mass scale, not the α–α binding, which sits one ℏ_q² rung lower. ρ_αα=ℏ_q² restates the match, not a derivation (numerology guard). No fit.

description: Lane 2 of bk-crossing-coordination (open item 3b, b_αα). Applies the proton VolDensity convention Vol/ℏ_q²×linking_weight to the α–α interface link 7²_1 (the one untried substrate-pure route named by the prior bare-tr_M probe). Result 1: the full VolDensity route OVERSHOOTS b_αα by 259× (H₄)/137× (H₃) — scope-(a) refutation; the ℏ_q²≈0.0098 Planck enhancement that lifts Vol(𝓑₃) to the GeV proton mass over-inflates the α–α bond. Result 2: the AME-implied α–α per-block density ρ_αα=b_emp·ℏ_q²/(m_e·Vol) equals ℏ_q² to 0.45% (ρ_αα/ℏ_q²=0.9955), so the literature m_e·Vol(7²_1) IS the VolDensity form with a density ρ_αα=ℏ_q² that cancels the denominator — the α–α binding sits one ℏ_q² rung below the rest-mass scale (proton ρ_p=linking_weight≈2.53 is O(1); ρ_p/ρ_αα≈259). OPEN (numerology guard): ρ_αα=ℏ_q² restates the match, not a derivation. No fit; no wiring; q₀ proton-anchored (no muon-cache straddle).
